title: iPhone Handoff will seamlessly share one number between two phones
summary: When iOS 27 lands later this month, it will have a feature called iPhone Handoff that lets you switch between two phones using the same number. It was briefly mentioned during the WWDC keynote back in June, but there were no details at the time. Now there's a demo clip showing how to set up […]
llm_summary: Apple’s upcoming iOS 27 will introduce “iPhone Handoff,” a feature that lets you use the same phone number on two separate iPhones—so you can seamlessly switch between devices without missing calls or texts. The functionality was hinted at during WWDC and a new demo shows how to set it up, promising smoother continuity for users who juggle multiple phones.
